master_script.hook: Ad kuch seconds mein koi reply nahi milta, aapke cafe ke liye?

hooks.text: Aapke cafe ka ad 30 sec mein koi reply nahi?
30% customers aapke ad dekh ke bhi swipe kar dete hain.
Maan lo aapka salon 9 baje booking miss karta hai.
Raat 11 baje WhatsApp se order aaya, aap busy, reply nahi diya.
Myth: Sirf photo post se sales double ho jati hai.
Ek animated ad aapke brand ko viral bana sakta hai.
